issues.secondTitle: CVE-2024-40896 affects libxml2 < 2.12.5 used via CocoaPods
issues.description: libxml2 before 2.12.5 has a use-after-free in xmlXIncludeAddNode that can be triggered by crafted XML documents, leading to remote code execution. This library is pulled in transitively through the Ono CocoaPods dependency used for HTML/XML parsing.

autoFix.title: Upgrade libxml2 to 2.12.5+
autoFix.description: Update the Ono CocoaPods dependency to a version that bundles libxml2 >= 2.12.5

issues.secondTitle: lodash < 4.17.21 allows prototype pollution via merge/zipObjectDeep
issues.description: lodash versions prior to 4.17.21 are vulnerable to Prototype Pollution via the set, setWith, and zipObjectDeep functions, potentially allowing attackers to modify object prototypes and inject malicious properties.

autoFix.title: Upgrade lodash to 4.17.21
autoFix.description: Run npm update lodash or update package.json to pin lodash >= 4.17.21

issues.mainTitle: Insecure Data Storage — Keychain Missing Accessibility
issues.description: The app stores sensitive authentication tokens in the iOS Keychain without specifying the kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly attribute. This means data may be accessible when the device is locked and could be included in unencrypted backups.

severityChange.reason: Ox determined this issue is exploitable only with physical device access, reducing effective severity

issues.secondTitle: App does not implement SSL/TLS certificate pinning for API connections
issues.description: The banking application communicates with backend APIs over HTTPS but does not implement certificate pinning. An attacker with network access (e.g., rogue Wi-Fi) could perform a man-in-the-middle attack using a forged certificate trusted by the device.

issues.mainTitle: SQL Injection in SQLite Query Builder
issues.secondTitle: User input concatenated directly into SQLite query in DataManager.swift
issues.description: In DataManager.swift line 142, user-supplied search text is concatenated directly into a SQLite query string without parameterized queries. This allows SQL injection that could read or modify the local SQLite database containing health records.

autoFix.title: Use parameterized SQLite queries
autoFix.description: Replace string concatenation with sqlite3_bind_text() parameterized query to prevent SQL injection. Change: let query = "SELECT * FROM records WHERE name = '\(searchText)'" to use ? placeholder with bound parameter.

issues.secondTitle: Alamofire 5.6.x bundles OpenSSL with known CVEs
issues.description: Alamofire 5.6.4 depends on an OpenSSL version with multiple known vulnerabilities including CVE-2024-0727 (denial of service) and CVE-2023-5678 (excessive time in DH key generation). Upgrading to Alamofire 5.8+ resolves these.

severityChange.reason: The OpenSSL vulnerabilities in this context are limited to denial of service; no remote code execution is possible through Alamofire usage pattern

autoFix.title: Upgrade Alamofire to 5.8+
autoFix.description: Update Package.swift to require Alamofire >= 5.8.0 which bundles patched OpenSSL

issues.mainTitle: Hardcoded API Key in Source Code
issues.secondTitle: Firebase API key found in GoogleService-Info.plist committed to repo
issues.description: A Firebase API key is hardcoded in GoogleService-Info.plist which is committed to the repository. While Firebase API keys are generally not secret, this plist also contains the database URL and storage bucket which could be used to enumerate resources.

issues.secondTitle: CVE-2024-50602 — libexpat before 2.6.4 allows DoS via XML parsing
issues.description: libexpat before version 2.6.4 has a vulnerability where XML_ResumeParser can crash when called after XML_StopParser, leading to a denial of service. This affects iOS apps using any XML parsing that depends on libexpat.

autoFix.title: Upgrade libexpat to 2.6.4+
autoFix.description: Update the CocoaPods dependency to pull libexpat >= 2.6.4

issues.secondTitle: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads set to YES in Info.plist
issues.description: The app's Info.plist has NSAllowsArbitraryLoads set to YES under NSAppTransportSecurity, disabling App Transport Security for all connections. This allows unencrypted HTTP traffic which can be intercepted.

severityChange.reason: Ox elevated severity because the app handles payment data, making cleartext traffic a higher risk

autoFix.title: Remove NSAllowsArbitraryLoads from Info.plist
autoFix.description: Set NSAllowsArbitraryLoads to NO and add exception domains only for hosts that require HTTP (e.g., legacy internal APIs)

issues.mainTitle: Outdated React Native with Known Vulnerabilities
issues.secondTitle: react-native 0.71.x has multiple known CVEs in bundled Hermes engine
issues.description: ShopEasy uses React Native 0.71.8 which includes the Hermes JavaScript engine with known vulnerabilities. The Hermes engine has buffer overflow and type confusion issues that could allow code execution through crafted JavaScript.

severityChange.reason: Ox elevated from High to Critical because the app processes payment card data and the Hermes RCE could lead to credential theft

autoFix.title: Upgrade React Native to 0.73+
autoFix.description: Update react-native to >= 0.73.0 in package.json. This is a major version upgrade that may require code changes for breaking API changes.
